note: Effective-dated fee-profile DATA for 794-event-fee-recompute, mirroring the fields of Kalshi GET /series/fee_changes (series_ticker, fee_type, fee_multiplier, scheduled_ts) as {profile_id, effective_from, ...parameters, source_pin} rows. The zkVM guest cannot read files, so the kernel embeds this table verbatim; this file is the human-readable data sheet and the two must move together. Rates are integer ratios (num/den); prices and fees are integer micro-dollars (1e-6 USD).

profiles.source_pin: docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding (sha256 706043bc) + kalshi.com/fee-schedule rendered in a real browser (sha256 fb7b72c8), retrieved 2026-10-31. No primary source states a schedule effective date; the Feb 5 vs Jul 7 2026 conflict stays open, so none is recorded.

docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees (sha256 2b2b8dcc), retrieved 2026-10-31. Maker rebate = share of taker fees collected (rebate_share semantics), never a negative theta. A fee-free category ships caller-declared (theta 0), not as a pinned venue row.

rows.source_pin: CFTC 40.6(d) weekly notification 2026-07-07 (sha256 2fef3084): taker coefficient raised 0.05 -> 0.06
CFTC 40.6(d) weekly notification 2026-09-29 (sha256 9860f229): straight trades Fee = 0.0695*C*p*(1-p)

profiles.combo_taker_formula: Fee = C*p*[0.0695(1-p) + 0.04(1-p)^4] (pinned letter 2026-09-29 Exhibit A, effective 12:00 a.m. ET Friday, September 25, 2026)

deferred_profiles: Robinhood, Crypto.com, ForecastEx and Coinbase are deferred per the staging row: only secondary, conflicting figures exist. A `tiered` family is out of scope unless a primary tiered schedule is pinned at claim.
